rules: Every process runs one cell trial at one committed, clean revision built in Release; HVO_EVIDENCE_REVISION equals that revision and the harness checks it against the assembly InformationalVersion.

S1 is the unchanged #1106 manifest run by docs/validation/issue-1106-qualification.sh with DOTNET_TieredCompilation=0, for comparability with the #1106 evidence. S2-S4 run with production runtime defaults (tiered compilation and dynamic PGO on) and record every DOTNET_* variable. The tc0-side-cell profile is labelled and is never production latency.

Each S2/S4 trial is a separate process with 5 warm-up and 30 measured operations. Trial medians are reported as median/min/max across trials; p95 is reported per trial and pooled across all measured operations, never from trial medians.

Measurement runs attach no collector. Attribution runs attach dotnet-trace (EventPipe) through the harness PID handshake; collector overhead is the attribution trial against the measurement trial median of the same cell. perf is used only where unprivileged sampling works; otherwise the index records it as unavailable with the host's perf_event_paranoid value.

Heavy work is serialized by flock -o on /tmp/hvo-1170-heavy.lock (#520 addendum 003) with MSBUILDDISABLENODEREUSE=1, UseSharedCompilation=false and UseRazorBuildServer=false, never runs dotnet build-server shutdown (#520 addendum 004), and is gated on the one-minute load average; tenants are recorded, not paused.

Regression rule (after against baseline, same cell and profile): median-of-trial-medians above max(5%, baseline trial-median spread); allocated bytes above 1%; any full-frame copy increase; peak RSS above max(5%, 32 MiB); any S4 drain increase. Unexplained regression blocks merge.
A harness failure is retained and reported; the runner exits nonzero after all processes finish.

baseline.cause: #520 addendum 003 line 20 required dotnet build-server shutdown before S1 and before every measured trial; the baseline S1 and measure packs ran under it.

after.cause: #520 addendum 004 withdrew it on every host because it stops every session's build servers; the runner no longer calls it.

methodAmendments.control: A W2 control pack at d942bd86 plus only this amendment, product source byte-identical to productBase, is compared against the baseline W2 cell before after is compared against baseline.
